fichas.title: Car wash facilities
fichas.summary: Public-service car washes provide environmentally friendly washing for cars and trucks. Mobile tyre-washing equipment is also used at building sites, tips, and landfill sites. Groundwater protection regulations apply. Water is reprocessed and recycled; fresh water covers evaporation losses, winter salt reduction, rinsing, and liquid-wax application.

fichas.title: Self-service car wash stalls
fichas.summary: Roofed or open-air stalls allow customers to clean cars using high-pressure cleaners and hand-washing brushes. Small installations have one or two places; larger installations can have up to 12 places served by a central services room. The illustrated plan gives stall dimensions and spacing.

fichas.title: Portal car wash
fichas.summary: A portal car wash uses a washing assembly that travels over a parked car. It occupies little space and can be installed outdoors, though indoor installation is preferred; a drive-through arrangement is ideal. The building must accommodate the portal when it is not operating. The stated capacities cover annual and hourly throughput.

fichas.title: Tunnel car wash
fichas.summary: A conveyor carries vehicles through fixed washing and after-care portals. The system supports high capacity and multiple washing programmes during the same pass. The text gives tunnel length and hourly and annual processing ranges.
